shared_elements: horizontal bands or rows of pattern
justification: Both surfaces include human/anthropomorphic imagery, circular motifs, and linear carved signs or bands, with the closest correspondence being a prominent circular/disc form associated with a figured composition. The main difference is that A is a frontal schematic anthropomorphic body covered with bold abstract markings, while B is a narrative relief with profile human figures, an overhead radiant disc, offerings, and dense sign columns, so the relationships and overall iconographic scheme do not match.
